$comment: Green-on-arrival baseline for the ticket factory.
WHY: scripts/factory/gate.sh must be able to tell an agent's regression apart
from a failure that was already red on main. Without this file every branch
looks broken and the gate is useless.
The 13 web failures that lived here WERE audit finding TEST-1 (TRO-223). They
were fixed on 2026-07-29 and their entries deleted, as this comment required.
Both suites are now green on arrival, so any failure the gate sees is new.
Identity format: <repo-relative test file>::<full test name>.

environment.note: api tests were run against a dedicated database because api/src/test/setup.ts TRUNCATEs 16 tables in beforeAll of every test file.

api.note: Re-measured at capturedAtCommit: 469 tests, up from 451 at the previous capture. This branch changed no api code. One standalone run, no flake observed.

resolved.note: All 13 entries removed because the tests now pass, not because they were reclassified. One was a source defect (the project 'weeks' tab lost its count label in 7713ef0), one was a test-harness defect (a fetch stub without headers, which made resetTimer force a logout), and 11 were assertions left behind by the sprint->week rename (7713ef0), the project tab reorder (b1e4c5a) and the sprint-tabs feature (9f77237).
resolved.counts: 151 tests at the previous capture and 172 when this branch re-measured (the suite grew on main in between). This branch adds 15 test-case declarations, some via it.each, and merging main brought in 5 further test files from other tickets. Measured on the branch after that merge: 214 tests across 24 files, 0 failing. Assertions in the three repaired files went from 131 to 147; no test was skipped and none deleted.
